title: Embracing Consistency: A One-Stage Approach for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Embracing Consistency: A One-Stage Approach for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Spatio-Temporal video grounding (STVG) focuses on retrieving the spatio-temporal tube of a specific object depicted by a free-form textual expression.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Thanks to these critical designs, STCAT enjoys more consistent cross-modal feature alignment and tube prediction without reliance on any pre-trained object detectors.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Thanks to these critical designs, STCAT enjoys more consistent cross-modal feature alignment and tube prediction without reliance on any pre-trained object detectors.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: In this paper, we present an effective one-stage transformer-fashion encoder-decoder based [35] framework, dubbed as Spatio-Temporal Consistency-Aware Transformer (STCAT) to cope with the aforementioned issues in the STVG task.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: The majority of current approaches [38, 34, 4, 48, 47] streamline the spatio-temporal video grounding as a two-stage pipeline, where the object proposals or tubelets are ﬁrstly generated by a pre-trained object detector (e.g., Faster RCNN [25]) and then all the candidates are ranked according to the similarity with the query.
